policy: Use batch1 for sources over64KiB, batch4 for16–64KiB, batch16 below16KiB. Each is a disjoint explicit selection on a newly frozen main implementation, with original sources/harnesses unchanged. Smaller batches bound compiler-host AST memory; larger batches for small files avoid repeated runtime compile overhead. Native containment remains300s pervariant. Prior OOM journals and complete-file extracts remain immutable.
